note: BlindSpot CI journeys, see docs/CI.md. Run: npx tsx src/ci.ts blindspot.config.json --brain scripted --serve

journeys.name: Book appointment (fixed clinic)
journeys.task: Book an appointment with Dr. Lee as Alex Doe (alex@example.com).

journeys.name: Book appointment (inaccessible clinic)
journeys.task: Book an appointment with Dr. Lee as Alex Doe (alex@example.com).
journeys.note: Known-bad example: the time slots cannot be selected with a screen reader, so this journey is expected to be blocked. It is reported but does not fail the build.

journeys.name: Checkout (fixed shop)
journeys.task: Buy 2 kg of apples and a loaf of bread, then check out with home delivery. Use the name Alex Doe, address 12 Elm Street, and accept the terms.

journeys.name: Checkout (inaccessible shop)
journeys.task: Buy 2 kg of apples and a loaf of bread, then check out with home delivery. Use the name Alex Doe, address 12 Elm Street, and accept the terms.
journeys.note: Known-bad example: the terms checkbox is a plain div, so a screen reader user cannot place the order. Reported, does not fail the build.
